description: This file defines a Scheduler class for managing migration jobs in Mattermost, including scheduling, job creation, and handling wedged jobs.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Manages migration job scheduling, including checking migration states, scheduling new jobs, and handling wedged jobs.

methods.name: MakeScheduler
methods.description: Factory function to create a new Scheduler instance.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Returns true indicating the scheduler is enabled.

methods.name: NextScheduleTime
methods.description: Calculates the next scheduled time for migration jobs, or nil if all migrations are complete.

methods.name: ScheduleJob
methods.description: Main method to determine and schedule the next migration job based on current migration states.

methods.name: createJob
methods.description: Creates a new migration job with the specified migration key and last done info.
